implementation_issues.description: The source gives conflicting GROWTH definitions: Table 4 specifies 100×(sales_{t−1}/sales_{t−(1+i)})^(1/i), i=3…5, while the narrative uses a different lag/history expression. The t−6 raw start follows the table definition; retain the conflict.
The Appendix A1 expected-value/residual formula has a corrupted summation glyph in the assigned reading; the candidate transcription is not source-confirmed.
The positive/negative RESAVP split and zero treatment are not reported, so its two regressor definitions are not unique.
The beta market-model frequency, estimation sample and window are not specified; the raw window remains unbounded.
EFF requires analyst-by-firm coverage counts over the entire I/B/E/S firm universe, not only focal sample firms; analyst and ticker history must be joined without survivor-only restriction.
Paper’s Compustat inputs came from the 1995 snapshot; current standardized products can differ in restatements, coverage and identifiers.
No analyst EPS split-adjustment product is proven in the local catalog; IBES management-guidance ID/split products do not cover these analyst forecasts and are not substitutes.
